job.title: Senior Software Engineer
job.description: NetBox Labs simplifies the full infrastructure lifecycle for the world’s most demanding technical environments. As the commercial steward of NetBox, the open-source infrastructure system of record trusted by 10,000+ organizations for more than a decade, NetBox Labs streamlines infrastructure procurement, modeling, deployment and management for both humans and AI agents.
responsibilities: Manage and enhance the backend infrastructure for NetBox Cloud.
Collaborate with multi-functional teams to ensure stable, scalable infrastructure.
Develop and maintain software features in accordance with user requirements and company standards.
Contribute to the improvement of existing software and infrastructure.
